a.lede: As Sony and PlayStation head into a digital-only era, new tech on its upcoming controllers could help make online purchases even more convenient for gaming.
a.title: This Sony patent would add a credit card reader to your PlayStation controller

b.lede: After over a decade of use, customers are going to need to switch to a less-efficient means of monitoring their favorite Sony products and gadgets.
b.title: Sony is ditching its cross-product support app for dedicated alternatives
